clips.caption:
Steve Jobs got fired from the company he built.

Jensen Huang almost couldn't make payroll before Nvidia became one of the most valuable companies on earth. J.K. Rowling was living out of her car, broke and divorced, before Harry Potter made her a billionaire.

Kevin Trudeau says every one of them had more disasters than the average person will ever face - and the disaster is exactly what built them.

The day everything falls apart isn't the end. It's the day your success actually starts, the moment you decide to turn it around.

What's the disaster in your life that could be your turning point?

#kevintrudeau #successmindset #mindsetmatters #entrepreneurtips #wealthhabits #businessmotivation

Kevin Trudeau's business partner split from him over a disagreement, and Kevin agreed not to teach memory seminars live again.

Everyone around him said his business and his livelihood were gone.

Then, at the Carnegie Deli in New York City, a stranger named Bobby Singer asked what he did for a living - and put him on TV.

That one conversation turned into $450 million in memory course sales and made Kevin the infomercial king.

The breakup he thought ended his career is the reason he got famous.

#kevintrudeau #successmindset #entrepreneurstory #wealthhabits #milliondollaridea #businessmotivation

The Federal Trade Commission sued Kevin Trudeau and banned him from TV infomercials for life.

Instead of fighting the headline, Kevin asked for that exact wording in the settlement - because a ban on TV couldn't stop him from writing a book.

So he wrote one exposing the FTC and the drug companies, called it Natural Cures They Don't Want You To Know About, and it hit #1 on the New York Times bestseller list for 26 weeks straight, selling over 50 million copies and outselling Harry Potter in hardback.

Getting banned from TV is what made him a bestselling author.

clips.caption:
Kevin Trudeau says there's one real difference between people who make it and people who don't: one reacts, the other responds.

When trouble hits, most people go into defense - they protect, hide, and hope it passes. Winners go on attack. They confront the problem head-on because they know they can handle it, and that something better is waiting on the other side.

Vince Lombardi put it simply: show him a good loser, and he'll show you a loser.

When you hit a wall, you don't quit. You go over it, around it, or you dig a tunnel through it and turn the mountain into a gold mine.

Which one are you - reacting, or responding?

#kevintrudeau #successmindset #wealthhabits #mindsetmatters #businessmotivation #entrepreneurtips

Kevin Trudeau says you can't eliminate a bad habit - you can only replace it with a better one.

When disaster hits, most people's habit is to panic, play victim, or go numb. Kevin teaches a different habit: say out loud, someday I'll look back at this and laugh - and actually laugh now instead of waiting for someday.

Physically laughing releases endorphins that change your body chemistry in real time, so you can look at the same problem completely differently.

It sounds simple, but it's the habit that turns a disaster into something you can handle today, like the old proverb says: fall down seven times, get up eight.

#kevintrudeau #successmindset #mindsetmatters #wealthhabits #personalgrowth #businessmotivation

To get a few ounces of gold, miners move tons and tons of dirt through bulldozers and wash machines. They're not looking for the dirt - they're looking for the gold.

Kevin Trudeau says life works the same way: without setbacks, there's no breakthrough. Without pain, there's no growth. Without disasters, there's no real success.

The day everything falls apart isn't the end of your story - it's the day your success actually begins, if you keep moving the dirt.

What dirt are you moving right now on the way to your gold?
